goal: WG-403: world_compare and world_timeline leave world_check; world_check is the staged parent of world_input, world_events, world_consistency and consumes guard_semantics

components.summary: Shared contracts, compact reports, clock and finite replay helpers
responsibilities: Derive required Guards from claim semantics and claim assertion kinds and validate shared contract shapes; validate event clocks, homogeneous time kinds and scenario-local event identities; own the shared per-Guard boundary semantics table and derive unmapped semantics only outside selected Guard boundaries; validate event-linked transitions, participant fields and reserved event-time names Keep node-scoped assertion semantics and clocks out of holder-local Guard derivation and time validation; reuse the canonical clock and native replay across mesh handoffs.

Provide pure event and token replay, norm activation and safe scalar scenario evaluation shared by Guards and claim assertions; expose unscoped event times in hours and replay linked token transitions in event order; activate norms from event-time fluents as well as static facts
Keep compact native reports and the conservative four-status aggregation
Apply finite in-memory variant patches by exact paths and ids; read the native event/token/scalar timeline without a separate simulation engine
Check declared event preconditions without assuming an order inside simultaneous groups; retain uncertainty after conflicting same-time writes until a definite later write.
The timeline shows every claim row with its result, every declared sub-model and every problem of the native report
side_effects: Read declared mapping files (YAML only when PyYAML is installed) and emit JSON only when requested

components.summary: Unit qualification that runs the derived Guards and checks the claim assertions against the model
responsibilities: Run each derived native Guard exactly once Resolve node rows only against parent_child descendants in a native mesh context; standalone references gap and summary-only nodes need no local Guard execution.
Evaluate each claim.asserts row against the world model; a false row fails the claim, an unresolved row is a gap, and a claim without assertions is not bound (gap)
Expose one row per problem and checked Guard/claim counts with a single final status; check optional entity registries across Guard inputs; expose the run_worldguard kernel through this one owner
Require each known-bad variant to produce its expected non-pass status/code; retain source references and event prefixes on full counterexamples
Compare only supplied observations with native world event times and causal scenario values, using declared time/variable tolerances and no writes or frozen artifacts.
Decorate only mapping event and transition records so malformed native records keep their original typed Guard result. Read entity uses only from mapping event records.
A single token's place agrees with the spatial relations declared at the same time: a contradiction fails, an unrelated place is a gap
side_effects: Execute selected native Guards and return a bounded report
